---
description: End the current Revibe course entirely and archive the active plan
agent: revibe
---

I want to end this course. Don't try to talk me out of it; do reflect honestly.

Steps:

1. Read `memory/MEMORY.md` and the active plan in `learning_plan/` (ignore `learning_plan/examples/`).
2. Update the active plan file: change `status: active` to `status: archived` in the frontmatter.
3. Update `memory/MEMORY.md`:
   - Move the plan reference out of "Active Plan" — that section should read "(none)".
   - Append a final Session Log entry containing today's date, what I covered overall, what I genuinely learned (only what I demonstrated, not what was merely shown), and one honest note on what's still shaky.
4. Give me a short, warm closing note — one paragraph, no fluff. Tell me what I'd be ready to learn next if I ever come back, and remind me that running `/revibe-start` later will pick up cleanly from a fresh intake or by reactivating this plan.

Do not delete the archived plan file. Past plans are part of the record.
